methods.candidate_workaround: Split independent surfaces, use cheap ref checks before clean-state checks, and give each attributable command one adequate bounded envelope.
methods.failure_signature: A composite startup or file-inspection wrapper exceeds its time envelope and withholds otherwise independent results.
methods.recurrence_guard: Never aggregate a long Git status or remote query with task-list and version operations whose results would be lost together.
methods.rollback: Give each timed-out wrapper zero evidence credit and inspect state before issuing a narrower probe.
methods.scope_boundary: Read-only workflow recovery only; no phase, scientific, authority, production, or routing credit beyond the observed probes.

methods.candidate_workaround: Preserve submitted assignments, emit the exact issues, generate a sequential candidate from the declared sixteen-seat cycle, and mark ownership changes as requiring confirmation.

methods.candidate_workaround: Invoke codex through cmd.exe /d /c so Windows resolves the npm command shim correctly.

methods.recurrence_guard: Use an explicit Windows command interpreter for .cmd or extensionless npm shims inside subprocess validators.
methods.rollback: Retain the crashed canonical attempt with zero credit and do not rerun the broad validator until the isolated command succeeds.
methods.scope_boundary: CLI version subprocess only; it does not validate other canonical checks or launch any CLI sibling.
methods.title: Windows npm shim invocation through cmd.exe
trigger_preconditions: A Python validator must verify a Windows npm-installed CLI version.

methods.recurrence_guard: Do not execute historical HEAD-count assertions as if an additive successor were still the sealed phase head.
methods.rollback: Retain the failed historical assertion and keep the base test byte-stable.
methods.scope_boundary: Base continuity only; immutable receipt reading does not replay or expand the sealed canonical suite.
methods.title: Immutable base-object continuity on additive successor heads
trigger_preconditions: A special continuation validates an already sealed base phase without rewriting its historical tests.
